attributes.description: One bar per STEP, clustered side by side at each time bucket, ordered by when each step first fired so the cluster reads left-to-right in pipeline order. The order is derived from the data, never from a hardcoded step list, so a different workflow orders itself.
attributes.title: Step outcomes over time

attributes.description: Completed / Failed / Cancelled over the same selection. Cancelled is coloured distinctly from Failed on purpose: a policy rejection and a defect send an operator to different places.
attributes.title: Outcome distribution
